name: dragon
description: Kill the ender dragon in the End. Needs a world whose End still has its dragon: a /summon'ed ender_dragon has no EnderDragonFight controller, so it hovers motionless and never circles, perches or attacks. This rung relies on the real fight, so it must not summon one.
goal:
You are on the End island near the bedrock fountain, wearing diamond armour and a carved pumpkin (the pumpkin is why endermen ignore you - do NOT take it off). Kill the ender dragon.
The `dragon_fight` reflex does the actual fighting for you, on the 250ms tick: it heals, breaks contact when it is losing, melees the dragon when it perches and leads it with the bow when it flies. A planning turn takes far longer than the dragon takes to kill you, so swinging is not your job.
Your job: check the reflex is on (reflex_set dragon_fight on), stay near the fountain so you are in reach when it perches, keep arrows and golden apples to hand, and watch. Expect your own tool calls to be preempted by the reflex - that is it working, not an error. Do not run long scripts that try to fight the dragon yourself; you will only take the body away from the reflex. There are no crystals left, so every hit sticks and its health never comes back. Never dig down here - below the island is the void. Say 'dragon dead' when it is gone.

commands: execute in minecraft:the_end run forceload add -32 -32 32 32
